# AuroBarber

AuroBarber is a SaaS management system for barbershops, developed by Aurosoft, a software house.

## Product

- Barbershop scheduling and online appointment booking
- Staff, services, clients, and commissions
- Cash register, payables, and cash-flow forecasting
- Tenant isolation and configurable licensing
- Optional application backups to Google Drive

## Site

https://barber.aurosoft.com.br/
